reference: The eerie light has faded completely, and the yard is dark again.
sk: Desivé svetlo úplne zhaslo a nádražie je zase tmavé.
cz: Děsivé světlo úplně zhaslo a nádraží je zase tmavé.
acceptable: The {eerie|creepy|spooky|scary} light has {faded completely|completely faded|gone out completely|completely gone out}, and the {yard|station|railway station|train station|rail yard} is dark again.

mistakes.text: The eerie light {faded completely|completely faded}, and the {yard|station} is dark again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Výsledok je vidieť teraz, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Výsledek je vidět teď, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The result is visible now, so Present Perfect is better: “has faded”.

mistakes.text: The eerie light has been fading completely, and the {yard|station} is dark again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej je úplne dokončený („completely“), preto Present Perfect Simple: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj je úplně dokončený („completely“), proto Present Perfect Simple: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The change is fully finished (“completely”), so use Present Perfect Simple: “has faded”.

mistakes.text: The eerie light has fade completely, and the {yard|station} is dark again.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “has”, use the past participle: “has faded”.

mistakes.text: The eerie light is faded completely, and the {yard|station} is dark again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Present Perfect sa tvorí s „has“, nie „is“: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Present Perfect se tvoří s „has“, ne „is“: „has faded“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Present Perfect is formed with “has”, not “is”: “has faded”.

mistakes.text: The eerie light has faded completely, and the {yard|station} has been dark again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Stav teraz vyjadruje Present Simple: „is dark again“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Stav teď vyjadřuje Present Simple: „is dark again“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A state right now needs Present Simple: “is dark again”.

source_issues: SK/CZ say 'nádražie/nádraží' (station), the reference says 'yard'; station variants accepted. SK/CZ 'zhaslo' = went out.
